0000_core-platform-phase-1.note: Foundational schema. Recover through application rollback plus database restore/forward compensation; do not synthesize destructive down SQL.

0001_location-domain.note: Preserve location data and compensate forward if a schema correction is required.

0002-organization-module-access.note: Module-access data and RLS changes are corrected forward; verify tenant policies after recovery.

0003-identity-based-login.note: Identity mapping participates in authentication and must not be dropped as an automated rollback.

0004-sync-login-identifiers.note: Trigger/function changes are restored or replaced through a reviewed forward migration.

0005-code-counters.note: Counter state may be business-significant; preserve state and compensate forward.

0006-default-location-context.note: Context relationships are corrected forward with FK/RLS validation.

0007-audit-events.note: Audit history is append-only evidence and must not be automatically removed during rollback.

0008-account-security-tokens.note: Recovery tokens are security state. Disable affected flows or compensate forward rather than restoring consumed tokens.

0009-mfa-state.note: MFA state must fail closed. Use reviewed forward correction and explicit account recovery procedures.

0010-operational-services.note: Notification, file, scheduler, and outbox records may carry durable work; preserve data and compensate forward.

0011-outbox-leasing.note: Lease columns are additive. A corrective migration may safely supersede them after workers are stopped.

0012-refresh-token-rotation.note: Consumed-token history is replay-detection security evidence and must not be rolled back into reusable credentials.

0013-notification-leasing.note: Lease/retry state is durable operational data; stop workers and compensate forward if required.

0014-customer-foundation.note: Customer records are business data; preserve them and correct forward if recovery is required.

0015-tenant-module-trigger-rls.note: Corrects tenant bootstrap trigger behavior under FORCE RLS by temporarily binding the new tenant context during core entitlement initialization and restoring the prior context.

0016-sales-quotation.note: Quotation business records, item lines, and numbering counters are preserved and corrected forward if recovery is required.

0017-sales-quotation-item-organization-i.note: Quotation item organization ownership is tightened through a forward-only tenant-safe composite foreign key.

0018-sales-quotation-canonical-audit.note: Quotation audit and optimistic-concurrency columns are corrected forward while preserving existing quotation and item data.

0019-sales-quotation-context.note: Quotation branch and financial-year context is added forward; existing rows are backfilled only from explicit organization defaults and otherwise preserved as nullable data requiring explicit reclassification.

0020-session-financial-year-context.note: Session financial-year ownership is additive and tenant-safe; preserve existing sessions and correct context forward.

0021-sales-order.note: Sales order and audit data are business records; preserve and correct forward.

0022-sales-delivery.note: Sales delivery traceability and line snapshots are business records; preserve and correct forward.

0023-sales-invoice.note: Sales invoice traceability and immutable line snapshots are business records; preserve and correct forward.

0024-sales-return.note: Sales return coordination records and line snapshots are business records; preserve and correct forward.

0025-sales-credit-note.note: Sales credit note traceability and immutable line snapshots are business records; preserve and correct forward.

0026-sales-pricing.note: Price-list definitions are business data; preserve and correct forward.

0027-sales-discount.note: Discount rules are business data; preserve and correct forward.

0028-sales-quotation-context-guard.note: Prevent implicit legacy quotation context assignment; explicit reclassification must be reviewed and authorized.

0029-inventory-item-master.note: Item master records are organization-owned business data; preserve and correct forward.

0030-inventory-foundation.note: Warehouse, stock, reservation, and movement records are authoritative Inventory business data; preserve and correct forward.

0031-sales-inventory-contract.note: Sales item and warehouse references are additive and historical rows remain nullable; preserve transaction data and correct forward.

0032-sales-inventory-contract-correction.note: Correct the composite foreign-key support index without removing Sales or Inventory business data.

0033-sales-delivery-inventory-fulfillmen.note: Add nullable delivery warehouse, item, and reservation references without rewriting historical delivery records.

0034-sales-return-inventory.note: Add nullable return warehouse and item references and permit the persisted Inventory completion state without rewriting historical returns.

0035-bounded-tax-foundation.note: Tax configuration is authoritative organization business data; preserve and correct forward.

0036-sales-invoice-tax-snapshot.note: Invoice tax snapshots are immutable transaction data; preserve and correct forward.

0037-bounded-finance-posting.note: Finance postings and Sales financial references are authoritative transaction data; preserve and correct forward.

0038-sales-commercial-snapshots.note: Commercial price and discount snapshots are historical transaction evidence; preserve them and compensate forward.
